06037.target: Prop 13 base-year value of single-family parcels whose land and improvement base years are both 2025 or 2026 (proxy for the transfer price).

legal_basis.text: Cal. Rev. & Tax. Code §110.1(a)-(b): the base year value is the fair market value on the date a purchase or change in ownership occurs (or new construction is completed). §110(b): on a purchase, full cash value is the purchase price paid, rebuttably presumed so for an arm's-length transaction.
legal_basis.note: Read from california.public.law (a reproduction of the code); leginfo.legislature.ca.gov blocked automated access.

split.training: Base-year 2022-24 resets (neighborhood statistics and model fit; cross-fitted so no home is in its own statistics).
split.development: Model chosen on 2024 resets using statistics from 2022-23, then locked (commit 290ce39).
split.test: Run once on 50723 base-year 2025-26 resets, with statistics from 2022-24 only. Test homes in training data: 0; test homes inside their own statistics: 0.

06037.what_is_tested: The LA model the page uses (coefficients in app/data/la_neighborhood_values.json), applied to homes that had not changed hands in the statistics window.

gate.reason: median error 16.3% is above the 15% limit
does not beat the neighborhood median alone (14.9% vs 12.7%)

previous_page_model.target: Prop 13 base-year value (Roll_LandValue + Roll_ImpValue) of single-family parcels whose land and improvement base years are both 2025 or 2026, on the 2026 roll: a proxy for the 2025/2026 transfer price.

legal_basis.text: Cal. Rev. & Tax. Code §110.1(a)-(b): the base year value is the fair market value on the date a purchase or change in ownership occurs (or new construction is completed). §110(b): on a purchase, full cash value is the purchase price paid, rebuttably presumed so for an arm's-length transaction.
legal_basis.note: Read from california.public.law (a reproduction of the code); leginfo.legislature.ca.gov blocked automated access.

previous_page_model.what_is_tested: The page's estimatePropertyMarketValue() from app/app.js, run verbatim with the parcel's roll values and base years withheld (the estimate shown for a home that has not recently sold). No pool/garage facts from OpenStreetMap or permits were supplied.
previous_page_model.baseline: The block group's typical home value alone (details m.hv).
caveats: Base-year resets are a proxy for sales: some are non-sale transfers reassessed at the assessor's appraisal (e.g. under Prop 19).
2025 base-year values on the 2026 roll include one annual inflation factor (at most 2%).

The block-group typical values were built from 2022-24 data by code that is not in this repository; no price index brings them to 2025-26, so some under-estimation is expected and is part of the measured error.
Only single-family use code 0100 was tested; condos, multi-unit and vacant land are not covered.

The page withholds its estimate when the neighborhood value is $2M or more (a guard written for the Census ACS top-code). In LA the neighborhood value comes from recorded sales, not ACS, so this guard withholds most $2M+ homes; those rows are counted as 'excluded' in the model metrics.

gate.reason: median error 18.8% is above the 15% limit

verification.method: Machine-run back-test: every tested record and every query is in the sample file; re-run the script to reproduce.
verification.notes: Verified means the metrics are computed from the public records as stated; it does not make the proxy a recorded sale.
